title: Medical Technologist I - Rex Core Laboratory

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist I to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Investigates problems with equipment, test results, specimens, and/or workflow. May participate on teams or perform special projects/assignments. May perform teaching of Clinical Laboratory Science students and Pathology residents and training of new employees. May serve as a technical resource. Performs quality control and equipment maintenance in the appropriate laboratory. Performs routine and less standardized test procedures which includes special chemical, microscopic and bacteriologic laboratory tests. Observes tests and reactions and provides data. Prepares specimens and reagents, solutions, heat, or filters as required. Reports results to healthcare providers. Consults/confers with health care providers regarding test results. Reviews test results to ensure accuracy of report and timely correction of errors.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's of Science degree in Medical Lab Science or Medical Laboratory Technology
Must meet eligibility requirements upon hire to sit for MT exam within 12 months of hire
Must obtain certification within one year of becoming exam eligible
No prior experience required
Preferred Requirements
Laboratory experience as a generalist

cond_0126.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist I to join our team. The Medical Technologist works alongside clinical staff to perform a variety of patient testing and administrative tasks in support of clinical activities at [Company name masked].
cond_0126.responsibilities:
Coordinates with staff to investigate problems with equipment, test results, specimens, and/or workflow.
May participate on teams or contribute to special projects/assignments.
May support teaching of Clinical Laboratory Science students and Pathology residents, and assist with training of new employees.
May serve as a technical resource.
Performs quality control and equipment maintenance in the appropriate laboratory.
Carries out routine and less standardized test procedures, including special chemical, microscopic, and bacteriologic laboratory tests.
Observes tests and reactions and shares data with the team.
Prepares specimens and reagents, solutions, heat, or filters as required.
Reports results to healthcare providers.
Consults and confers with healthcare providers regarding test results.
Reviews test results to help ensure accuracy of reports and timely correction of errors.
cond_0126.requirements:
Requires Bachelor's of Science degree.
Must meet eligibility requirements upon hire to sit for MT exam within 12 months of hire.
Must obtain certification within one year of becoming exam eligible.
No prior experience required.
Laboratory experience as a generalist is preferred.
Must have a Medical Lab Science or Medical Laboratory Technology degree.

Coordinates with staff to investigate problems with equipment, test results, specimens, and/or workflow.
May participate on teams or contribute to special projects/assignments.
May support teaching of Clinical Laboratory Science students and Pathology residents, and assist with training of new employees.
May serve as a technical resource.
Performs quality control and equipment maintenance in the appropriate laboratory.
Carries out routine and less standardized test procedures, including special chemical, microscopic, and bacteriologic laboratory tests.
Observes tests and reactions and shares data with the team.
Prepares specimens and reagents, solutions, heat, or filters as required.
Reports results to healthcare providers.
Consults and confers with healthcare providers regarding test results.
Reviews test results to help ensure accuracy of reports and timely correction of errors.
cond_0162.requirements:
Requires Bachelor's of Science degree.
Must meet eligibility requirements upon hire to sit for MT exam within 12 months of hire.
Must obtain certification within one year of becoming exam eligible.
No prior experience required.
Laboratory experience as a generalist is preferred.
Must have a Medical Lab Science or Medical Laboratory Technology degree.

No prior experience required — this role is open to candidates just starting out.

Some laboratory experience as a generalist is a plus, but not expected.
